queries.result: The official Shulan government homepage links to the Shulan Natural Resources Bureau information-disclosure area. Its catalog contains a 不动产登记信息 category, and the public catalog endpoint returned Shulan Real Estate Registration Center document metadata; no map/API geometry was exposed.

registryEvidence: The official Shulan government homepage links to 舒兰市自然资源局 (Shulan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau). The bureau's official information-disclosure catalog exposes a 不动产登记信息 category; its public JSONP list response returned records whose publisher is 舒兰市不动产登记中心 (Shulan Real Estate Registration Center). This evidences a local registry custodian, but not public parcel geometry access.
